dancers.name: Ciara Miller
dancers.knownFor: Summer House • model • former travel nurse
dancers.bio: Bravo reality star, model and former travel nurse best known for Summer House. Ciara has a legitimate dance foundation: she has said she grew up dancing and studied ballet for about 10 years, which gives her one of the clearest early skill signals among the announced cast.

dancers.name: Maura Higgins
dancers.knownFor: Love Island UK • The Traitors • TV presenter
dancers.danceBackground: Irish dancing as a child • Dancing on Ice contestant
dancers.bio: Irish television personality who broke out on Love Island UK and later became a presenter and a runner-up faithful on The Traitors. She did Irish dancing as a child and competed on Dancing on Ice, so she already has experience learning choreography and performing under pressure.

dancers.name: Jackson Olson
dancers.knownFor: Savannah Bananas • Banana Ball • social media
dancers.bio: Savannah Bananas baseball player and social-media personality whose job already blends elite athleticism with crowd entertainment. Formal dance training has not been publicly established, but coordination, stamina, stage comfort and the Bananas' choreographed showmanship make him an intriguing athletic upside pick.

dancers.name: Guillermo Rodriguez
dancers.danceBackground: No formal dance background publicly established
dancers.bio: Longtime Jimmy Kimmel Live! personality who went from studio security guard to one of late-night TV's most recognizable comedy sidekicks. He brings enormous likability and performance comfort, but no notable formal dance background has been announced. His confirmed pro is two-time Mirrorball champion Witney Carson.
